name: scope-ledger
description: Per-goal scope ledger (.claude/scope-ledger.local.md, converge or harvest mode; the next request on the same line of work is appended with `add`, not a new ledger) plus a per-repository follow-ups backlog, a `scope facts` script that computes the mechanical half of a finding's triage (inside the branch diff or not, sibling occurrences, MUST-rule candidates — also the neutral state for a calibrated classifier) and six fail-open hooks: the first source write without a ledger — through Edit/Write or through sed -i / perl -pi / redirects / cp / mv / patch in Bash — is denied once; the first prompt of a session gets a non-blocking reminder; review entries (a Skill call, a typed slash command, or a Workflow run such as `tree` with recipe review or `claude-security:scan`) inject a mode-aware finding-triage policy — in full once per session, a one-line pointer after — (adopt what belongs to this change plus exploitable security findings, sibling defects, MUST rules and boy-scout fixes; defer the rest with severity, reason and destination; deferring is scheduling, not dismissal) and count rounds; a Stop with open in-scope items is blocked once per state; SessionStart replays the ledger and announces open follow-ups. Keeps review-driven work from expanding past the original request without letting real bugs or security findings be skipped.
